design_concept: The map is the hero. Utilizing a 'Control Room' structure where the primary canvas is an edge-to-edge interactive map, overlaid with floating, technical glassmorphism panels. The design mimics professional GIS software (like Kepler.gl or CARTO) rather than standard SaaS.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Dense data arrays within floating panels. High negative space over the map area to let the geographic data breathe.

layout_structure.top_nav: absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 h-16 bg-panel_glass backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border flex items-center px-6
layout_structure.left_sidebar: absolute top-20 left-4 bottom-4 z-40 w-80 flex flex-col gap-4 pointer-events-none
layout_structure.right_sidebar: absolute top-20 right-4 bottom-4 z-40 w-80 pointer-events-none transition-transform duration-300

panels.style: bg-[#14171F]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#282D3D] shadow-2xl shadow-black/50 pointer-events-auto overflow-hidden
panels.usage: Use for the Left Sidebar (Filters/KPIs), Right Sidebar (Analytics), and Map Popups.

kpi_strip.style: grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 border-b border-[#282D3D] pb-4 mb-4

map_popup.style: bg-[#14171F] border border-[#282D3D] rounded-lg shadow-xl p-4 min-w-[240px]

controls.toggle_item: data-[state=on]:bg-[#282D3D] data-[state=on]:text-white text-secondary text-sm rounded-sm px-3 py-1.5 transition-colors

buttons.secondary: bg-[#1C202A] text-white border border-[#282D3D] hover:bg-[#282D3D] transition-colors

motion_and_interaction.panels: Slide in from edges with a slight fade. Use transform-gpu for smooth rendering.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Interactive list items (like courses or countries) should have a bg-[#282D3D] highlight on hover.
motion_and_interaction.map_interactions: Smooth fly-to animations when clicking clusters or countries. Tooltips/popups fade in swiftly.

images.description: High-tech dark mode WebGIS dashboard visualization with neon amber and cyan accents.
Abstract dark geometric grid representing global distance education with glowing nodes.
Close-up view of a world map.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. This is a dual-purpose application: A landing page describing the GOLDEN plugin, and the Dashboard itself. Build a routing structure or distinct views.
2. For the Dashboard: Use react-leaflet or a similar mapping library. Make the map occupy 100% of the screen height and width. Use a dark matter or dark base map tile (like CartoDB Dark Matter).
3. Build floating glassmorphism panels (using the 'panels.style' classes) that sit ON TOP of the map canvas using absolute positioning.
4. Implement mock data for student locations, grades (0-100), courses, and IPs to feed the map visualization.
5. Use Recharts for the Analytics panel (Top Countries bar chart, Grade Distribution histogram) applying the primary/secondary accent colors.

6. Landing page should be built using the provided `marketing_hero_bg` and `marketing_section_bg` media URLs. Use a highly technical, dark mode aesthetic for the marketing page to match the tool's vibe.
7. Font usage: Import `Chivo`, `IBM Plex Sans`, and `IBM Plex Mono` via Google Fonts. Map numbers, coordinates, and KPIs must use `IBM Plex Mono`.
8. Ensure every interactive element uses `data-testid` properties for robust testing.
